blocks.x: Just the name and the date, right?
That means we got to hang out more. We haven’t seen each other for two years. We’ve got to catch up. You’re looking good though, man.
My name is David Baker. The date is September 7th, 2008. I’m going to be doing the interview – oral history project – with my very dear friend Quincy Jones.
